title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Step for the Owner's Maintenance Portfolio at Review
content:
Where the owner holds an active preventive maintenance agreement whose annual price stands at or above
20000 US dollars and the installments that fell due on it in the last 12 months are cleared by the
payments received on it, a step of 0.12 is added. Where the owner holds an active preventive maintenance
agreement whose installments in that period are cleared, a step of 0.05 is added. In any other case no
step is added for the owner's other accounts with the company.

The agreement, its standing, its annual price, the installments that fell due on it and the payments
received on it are read from the customer's Preventive Maintenance Agreements records over the 12 months to the day of the review, the step standing at the review of a rate program held under the Demand Service Rate Programs.

| The owner's Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing | Annual price of that agreement | Installments of the last 12 months against its payments | The step |
|---|---|---|---|
| an active agreement | 20000 US dollars or more | cleared by the payments received | 0.12 |
| an active agreement | below 20000 US dollars | cleared by the payments received | 0.05 |
| an active agreement | any | not cleared by the payments received | no step is added |
| no active agreement | any | any | no step is added |

**Both sides of the price (hypothetical).** An owner whose active preventive maintenance agreement is
priced at 20000 US dollars a year with its installments cleared takes the step of 0.12, that price
standing at the figure rather than below it; an agreement priced at 19500 US dollars with its
installments cleared takes 0.05. An agreement of either price whose installments of the last 12 months
are not cleared by its payments takes no step at all.
